reason: Having refused third-party cloud tools for years out of fear of client ITR and PAN leaks, I will not pay upfront until I verify on the free pilot that files remain strictly in our Google Drive and folder recoveries work reliably.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder, and can I truly trust that Docketra won't expose or corrupt our sensitive client files?
would_change_my_mind: Proving through the free pilot that accidental folder deletions restore cleanly in one click and that article assistants are strictly blocked from downloading client documents to personal laptops.
